messages:
sara: Heads-up — 9 bus is crawling. Downed tree at 3rd & Pine, whole corner is a splash zone :umbrella:  — anyone on the route?
omar: I’m on it, stuck behind the detour. Driver just said ‘unexpected landscaping’. :grimacing:  
alex: ugh, just missed the 9 and the next one is delayed 20m. debating scooter vs wait.
commute-bot: ⚠️ Service alert: MUNI 9 trolley delayed due to obstruction at 3rd St & Pine. Expected 25-35 min delay. https://muni.status/alerts
marie: anyone in the office who can nab an extra pair of dry shoes? mine are soaked. happy to repay with snacks. :cookie:
ryan: I can bring spare sneakers — arriving in ~30. where should I leave them?
sara: leave at reception with a note for Marie, thanks ryan!! :pray:
omar: pro tip — if you have the umbrella rack under the stairs it stays mostly dry today. learned the hard way.
alex: FYI Caltrain replacement shuttle is running ahead of schedule (lol?) so if you’re heading south that might be faster than looping around the flooded bits.
marie: turning into a logistics thread — who knew commute coordination would be our team sport? :sweat_smile:
commute-bot: Weather update: Heavy showers through 10:30am, minor flooding possible in low-lying crosswalks. Plan extra time.
ryan: on my way now, will drop shoes at 10:05. anyone wanting a lift from Mission st stop DM me — I’m carpooling back to the office.
omar: thanks ryan! also heads-up for remote folks: office plant by the kitchen got a tiny waterfall, small towel sent to clean. :droplet: :plant: 
sara: anyone else working from home because of this? might hang for a bit longer — better zoom call hair. :joy:
alex: WFH today, but I’ll swing by later once downtown drains. keep me posted if the 9 reroutes permanently.
marie: huge thanks to ryan + reception. crisis averted. coffee on me tomorrow for the damp-foot brigade. :coffee:
